title: Google Quantum AI COO says the company declined funding from the $2B Trump administration grant because "conditions" attached would have slowed its work (J.D. Capelouto/Semafor)
summary: J.D. Capelouto / Semafor: Google Quantum AI COO says the company declined funding from the $2B Trump administration grant because “conditions” attached would have slowed its work — Google didn't take funding from the Trump administration for quantum computing because of “conditions” …
contentText:
J.D. Capelouto / Semafor :

Google Quantum AI COO says the company declined funding from the $2B Trump administration grant because “conditions” attached would have slowed its work   —  Google didn't take funding from the Trump administration for quantum computing because of “conditions” …
